prompt: When Taylor Swift first released her studio album "1989," how many studio albums had Katy Perry already released?
answer:
When Taylor Swift released **_1989_ on October 27, 2014**, Katy Perry had already released **four studio albums**:

1. _Katy Hudson_ (2001)  
2. _One of the Boys_ (2008)  
3. _Teenage Dream_ (2010)  
4. _Prism_ (2013)
